rule: Edit run.py only; keep cp run.py run_md.py before every push
Pin openmm=8.3.1 in the micromamba env (8.6+nvrtc13.3 rejects sm_60/sm_70)
Never rely on --accelerator to choose the GPU; design for the assigned one
Reinstall the pinned kaggle CLI every fresh sandbox (kaggle==2.2.4; key file persists, package does not)
Mount datasets via /kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>; find_input_dir() tries that first, then falls back to /kaggle/input
After dataset re-upload, expect minutes of mount lag; poll, don't fix working code
Rebuild restraint CustomExternalForce per stage; never bare setParticleParameters on 8.3
Re-center complex into [0,box)^3 BEFORE solvation; apply same shift to ligand+ions (RECELL)
Restrain to MINIMIZED coordinates, never raw input coordinates
Remove the previous stage's restraint force before adding the next (removeForce)
Use getState(getEnergy=True)+.getKineticEnergy()/.getPotentialEnergy() (no 8.6 kwargs on 8.3)
Rebuild ligand via VF2 heavy-atom match + AddHs(addCoords=True); verify InChIKey vs PubChem; never EmbedMolecule+AlignMol
Do not chase post-min |F|max~3700 to zero; equilibration absorbs it
OPC O-M same-residue 0.0159 nm pair is not a clash; exclude same-residue+bonded pairs
Plan >=3 sessions: 25,000,000 steps = 29h vs ~12h cap; checkpoint every 50 ps and resume — NEVER plan a single-session 100 ns run
Run exactly ONE bounded supervisor loop, only when the human asked for it; stop on done or 3 failures
kernel-metadata.json MUST contain "enable_gpu": true, and the first log lines after system creation MUST show "platform CUDA" — verify before walking away from a push

production kernels MUST fail fast when the CUDA platform is unavailable (CPU allowed only in MBZ_DRY smoke mode) and MUST log steps/s so a slow-burn CPU session is detectable from the first checkpoint
evidence: B1 took 22531 s vs ~3.5 min expected (TRAP-23). Runtime enforcement is the hard gate; preflight G22 only WARNs because statically proving a fallback is unguarded is heuristic — the blocker-grade static guarantees are G21 (enable_gpu) + the post-push 'platform CUDA' log check

rule: calibration-before-production: a 5 ns positive-control run (orlistat in 1LPB, dt 2 fs, no HMR) must pass ALL 12 literature gates CAL-01..CAL-12 (registry/calibration.json) before production runs are trusted on a new pipeline
evidence: Veeramachaneni 2015 10 ns discrimination — retained vs ejected ligands (Ser152 64-77% vs 8.47/15.35 A)

rule: ledger hygiene: every Kaggle START gets an END entry even on cancel or failure, with gpu_minutes taken from kaggle quota
